text: I can name three reasons to make a step asynchronous and one case where it must stay synchronous.
I can calculate the backlog a traffic spike creates and how long it takes to drain.
I can explain competing consumers and say what limits how far adding workers helps.
I can draw a fan-out design that gives each service its own copy of an event and spreads work across workers inside each service.
I can choose push or pull for a consumer and explain how backpressure works in each.
